book.name: Maluko
book.title: Lijambu la Amboni ngati ejuandiki Maluko

content: Yesu andamisa mundu jojulei kuboka
Yesu jajingala kabee mu nyumba jukuketangane Ayaudi, nu nkati je mola jwabii mundu jokulei kuboku.
Momuje, bandu bangi batenda kundingali jombi anndamisa mundu we jola Lisoba lu Kupomulela bapala apata ndela jukuntaki.
Yesu ampwagila mundu jokulei kuboku jola, “Hikaa palongi pamba.”
Henu Jaalalukiya, “Boo sakaka lee Lisoba lu Kupomulela kuhenga lijambu la sape au lalyaa, kunzangatii mundu au kunhumisa? Kunhokoo mundu au kunkoma?” Lakini bombi ngasibapwagiki sindo.

Yesu jaalingaliya bandu boti kwi ingwinya nukugubona usungu ndaba mioju jabu ngasebapai anzangatya mundu jola. Ndipala ampwagila jojulei kuboku jola, “Nyosha kuboku!” Najombi ejanyosha kuboku kwaki kola kwatenda kulama.
Ndipala, aka Afalisayu bapita kunza, baketangana na bandu kuhuma kwaka Helodi, bajetanganya kutumbulii kutaputa indela jukunkoma Yesu.
Nsambi wa bandu mulutengu junhanga
Yesu jaboka pala na banafunzi baki, jajenda mulutengu junhanga uku Galilaya na bandu bingi batenda kunzengalee. Bandu bahika kuhuma ku Yelusalemu nuku Yudea,
nuku Idumea na kwii juku losi luku Yoludani na ku Tilo nuku Sidoni. Bandu haba boa bunzendila Yesu ndaba jeni babii ajogwini gajabia juhengiki.
Yesu jaapwagila banafunzi baki bunhandalya nhwatu gumu, ndaba likundi lya bandu lyatenda kunhinya.
Ndaba jabia jalamisi bandu bingi, na agonzu bote bahinyana beni na beni kupala kungusa jombe.
Na bandu bababii ni ilombu pabumbona, biliabua pai palongi jaki nu kujamalii, “Wehapa wa Mwana waka Sapanga!”
Lakini Yesu jaakanakya baapwagi bandu jombi nyanye.
Yesu jahagu Atumi komi na habeli
Yesu jakwela kukitombi, na kakema bajaapala mweni. Na bombi nukunzengale,
najombi jahagula bandu komi na habeli, bajaakema atumi. Jaapwagila, “Nunhagwi mwanganya mmbia pamu nane. Kabee nuntuma mwakalandila bandu.
Na mwikubaa nu uwesu ukubenga ilombu.”
Henu bandu bala bajahagwi komi na habeli babii haba, Simoni jojapataa liina la Petili kuhuma kwaka Yesu,
Yakobu na Yohana bana baka Zebedayu Yesu jaakema aka kilongu haba Bonigesi, maana jaki, “Bandu bini kipyau,”
Andilea na Pilipi na Batolomayu na Matei na Tomasi na Yakobu mwana waka Alufayo na Tadei na Simoni joankema Zelote maana jaki mundu jojukomane nndema waki,
Na Yuda Isikaliote, joang'anumbuka Yesu.
Yesu na Beluzebuli
Yesu jajenda kunyumba. Bandu bingi bakusanyika kabee, mbaka Yesu na banafunzi baki ngasebapatiki muda gwakula posu.
Ndipala, alongumundu pabapata lijambu le ele bajenda kunzuku ndaba bandu bapwaaga, “Juyowiki mwanamangongu.”
Naka Abola bamalagalaki babahuma ku Yelusalemu bapwaaga, “Hajoo jubii ni Lijobi! Kabee jubenga ilombu kwa makili guku nkolongu jwi ilombu.”
Papuje Yesu jaakema, jaapwagila kwa malenganesu, “Lijobi liwesaboo kulibenga nkolongu jwi lijobi yenge?
Nagubii ukolongu gumu gogubaganiki makundimakundi gagakomana, ukolongu we ogu gwiitenda kuhabuka.
Kabee najibii nyumba jejibaganiki makundimakundi gagapengana, nyumba jeeji jiitenda kuhalabika.
Nahela, ana gubii ukulongu wi ilombu gubaganiki makundimakundi ngagwiwesi kudumo, ila gwihoba ngane.
“Ngamundu jojuwesa kutukalii nyumba jaka mundu jojubii na makili nukunyaga mali gaki. Mbaka ankonga hoti mundu jwana makili jola, ndi jiwesa kunyaga mali gee.
“Numpwagi sa sakaka, Sapanga jaalekakya bandu mahakau gabu pamu nukuntondoka kwabu,
lakini joantondo Loho jaka Sapanga, Sapanga ngahandekakele mahakau gaki, jwiitama na mahakau gaki masoba goa.”
Yesu japwaaga hela ndaba bandu bapwaaga, “Jubii ni kilombu.”
Anyongo baka Yesu na alongu baki
Anyongo baka Yesu na alongu baki bahika pala nukujema kunza, buntuma mundu kunkema.
Nsambi wa bandu watemi papu kunyongolota Yesu. Ndipala mundu jumu ampwagila Yesu, “Anyongo na alongu baku abii kunza, atenda kugukema.”
Yesu jaapwagila, “Anyongo bangu ne naka alongu bangu ne ndi akanyane?”
Papuje jalingalya bandu babatemi kun'yongolota nukupwaga, “Nndingalya! Naabona bamba ngati nyongowangu naka alongu bango.
Mundu jokapi jojuhenga gajupala Sapanga, ndi amabu bangu na nndombu wa nu mmbeli wa.”
